title: How Long Does a Cut Onion Last in the Fridge?

seo.title: How Long Does a Cut Onion Last in the Fridge?
seo.meta_description: Chopped or sliced onion can be refrigerated in a sealed container for about 7–10 days at 40°F or below. Discard sooner if moldy, slimy, watery, or foul-smelling.
seo.search_intent: Know how long cut onion keeps refrigerated and which spoilage signs matter.

excerpt: A cut onion can generally be kept about 7–10 days in the refrigerator when stored at 40°F (4°C) or below in a sealed container. That range is a storage guideline, not a guarantee: mold, slime, watery breakdown, or a clearly abnormal odor are reasons to discard it sooner.
content_html:
A whole dry onion can last for weeks in a cool, ventilated place. Once cut, the situation changes: the protective skin is gone, moisture is released, and the tissue is more exposed to contamination and deterioration.

The practical range: 7–10 days

The National Onion Association, citing USDA guidance, says chopped or sliced onions can be refrigerated in a sealed container for 7 to 10 days at 40°F (4°C) or below.

You do not need to aim for day 10 every time. Flavor and aroma change too, so earlier use usually gives better quality.

How to store cut onion

  1. Use a clean airtight container.
  2. Refrigerate promptly after cutting.
  3. Do not leave it sitting at room temperature for hours.
  4. Keep it away from raw meat or seafood juices.

A sealed container also prevents the onion odor from spreading throughout the refrigerator.

Discard signs

Visible mold, slime, cloudy liquid, very soft watery areas, or clearly rotten odors are reasons to throw it away. Cut onion naturally smells more intense than a whole onion, so distinguish normal sulfur aroma from sour or decomposed odors.

Can cut onion be frozen?

Yes. Chopped onion can be frozen for cooked dishes. It loses crispness, so it works better in soups, sauces, and sautés than in fresh salad.

Properly sealed and cold, roughly a week is reasonable; if the texture or appearance is wrong, do not let the calendar talk you into using it.

faq.question: How long does half an onion last in the refrigerator?
faq.answer: About 7–10 days is a common guideline when it is sealed and held at 40°F (4°C) or below.

faq.question: Should a cut onion be wrapped?
faq.answer: Yes. Use an airtight container or a tight food-safe wrap.

faq.question: What if the cut surface is just a little dry?
faq.answer: Minor drying can be trimmed, but mold, slime, watery decay, or a rotten odor are reasons to discard the onion.
